thread:
Leah (AE): Quick one — BeaconHealth is ready to sign but asking for a custom billing schedule and a small Net45 carveout for partner-managed services. Need deal desk + finance sign-off before I push the contract.

Leah (AE): Deal summary: 2-year enterprise commit, list price $440,000 total. Asking: Year 1 paid annual upfront, Year 2 split across quarters. Partner-managed services (third-party ops) ~$30k to be invoiced separately on Net45. Also asking for 10% discount for 2-yr commit.

Leah (AE): Proposed invoice language/snippet:
```
Invoice schedule:
Year 1: $220,000 due at execution (annual upfront)
Year 2: $110,000 invoiced Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4 (each $27,500) Net30
Partner services (third-party): $30,000 invoiced Net45
```

Leah (AE): They want the partner services separated because their vendor needs 45 days to cut a PO. Security questionnaire is signed off (secq v2.1), but POC acceptance criteria requires a sign-off doc before first invoice — Nora is running the POC next week.

Frank (Deal Desk): @Leah thanks. A few quick checks: 1) Is Year 2 billing obligated (committed) or contingent on usage? 2) Is the 10% discount on ARR or on total committed value? 3) Any required SSO/KMS commitments that would change billing?

Leah (AE): 1) Year 2 is committed (customer wants multi-year pricing guarantee). 2) 10% off ARR (applies to the Redwood service portion only, not partner services). 3) No additional infra commitments; they want standard KMS integration only.

Maria (Finance): We can do annual upfront + quarterly invoicing for Year 2. Net45 for partner services is atypical but OK if we put partner services on a separate invoice and explicitly exclude from our payment SLA. Need to confirm aging/collections process — recommend an approval note from Finance.

Sam (Legal): We'll need to update SOW & invoicing clause. Suggest: add clause that partner services are invoiced separately and Redwood isn't liable for vendor payment timing; cash application for Redwood remains per Redwood invoice terms. Also flag: for multi-year commits, include early termination / refund mechanics.

Nora (Solutions): POC timeline: start Mon, 2-week run, acceptance criteria are attached in the doc I shared. POC sign-off expected before Year1 invoice? Leah, you said they want invoice at execution. If so, we need an internal agreement that POC acceptance doesn't block invoice.

Leah (AE): Correct — customer will sign and pay Year1 at execution. POC is a gating item for a feature parity checklist, not for the invoice. We'll note that in SOW.

Frank (Deal Desk): Ok. Ask: deal requires special pricing approval (10% on a 2-yr commit) and Net45 carveout. I'm escalating to pricing committee. @Maria can you write a short approver line for Finance? Also we need an accounting-friendly payment schedule for the invoice system.

Maria (Finance): Approve Net45 for partner services only, contingent on partner's invoice referencing BeaconHealth PO# and Redwood SOW ID. Approve 10% discount on Redwood service for 2-yr committed ARR of $330k (post-partner). Will require AR note: "Partner services invoiced separately; Redwood payment terms apply to Redwood invoices."

Frank (Deal Desk): Thanks. @Sam, please draft the SOW language change and add a clause: "Partner invoices will be invoiced separately and may have Net45 terms; Redwood is not guarantee of third-party payment timing." Also add a cap on refunds if early termination occurs.

Sam (Legal): Will draft. ETA 24 hours.

DealBot: Pricing committee escalated by Frank. Ticket ID: PC-2026-8843.

Leah (AE): Awesome — once Sam drops SOW language and Finance confirms line, I'll circulate final redline and request signature. Nora will proceed with POC but will not withhold invoice.

Nora (Solutions): POC kickoff scheduled. Will post acceptance note in thread when complete. :thumbsup:

Leah (AE): Thanks team — tagging for visibility. If committee OKs, I’ll request Legal & Finance stamping and then send for signature.

Frank (Deal Desk): Noted. Leaving a reminder to attach the secq bundle and vendor PO requirement in the contract.

Maria (Finance): Filing approval note in our system. Please cc finance@redwood when you send final SOW.

Sam (Legal): Draft done and uploaded to the contract folder: /contracts/beaconhealth/2026/SOW-v3. I added the partner billing clause and early termination refund schedule.

Leah (AE): Perfect — I'm sending final redline to BeaconHealth now. Will update thread when signed.

DealBot: Contract signed by BeaconHealth — recorded at 1765015799. Invoice to be generated per schedule.
